Tasks.Name: SetMachineAccountQuota
Tasks.Description: Set ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota to 0 to prevent unprivileged users from joining computers to the domain

Tasks.Name: RaiseDomainFunctionalLevel
Tasks.Description: Raise the domain functional level to the target version

Tasks.Name: RaiseForestFunctionalLevel
Tasks.Description: Raise the forest functional level to the target version

Tasks.Name: EnableRecycleBin
Tasks.Description: Enable the Active Directory Recycle Bin optional feature

Tasks.Name: EnablePAMFeature
Tasks.Description: Enable the Privileged Access Management (PAM) optional feature

Tasks.Name: DisableAnonymousAccess
Tasks.Description: Disable anonymous LDAP read access by removing ANONYMOUS LOGON from Pre-Windows 2000 Compatible Access group

Tasks.Name: DeployT0AuthPolicy
Tasks.Description: Create a dedicated Authentication Policy and Silo for Tier 0 accounts

Tasks.Name: EnableReplicationNotify
Tasks.Description: Enable the Change Notification flag (USE_NOTIFY) on all inter-site replication links

Tasks.Name: ConfigureCentralStore
Tasks.Description: Create the Group Policy Central Store by copying PolicyDefinitions to SYSVOL

Tasks.Name: ExtendLAPSSchema
Tasks.Description: Extend the Active Directory schema for Windows LAPS

Tasks.Name: RestrictDNSDynamicUpdate
Tasks.Description: Remove CreateChild (dnsNode) from Authenticated Users on all AD-integrated DNS zones and grant it to Domain Computers only

Tasks.Name: AddDNSSecurityRecords
Tasks.Description: Add a WPAD sinkhole A record and a wildcard (*) TXT record to a DNS zone

Tasks.Name: FixDNSRecordOwnership
Tasks.Description: Set the owner of each DNS node to the matching domain computer account (e.g. SRV01 -> SRV01$)

Tasks.Name: ResetADObjectOwnership
Tasks.Description: Reset the owner of all user and computer objects in AD to Domain Admins

Tasks.Name: ConfigureLAPSADPermissions
Tasks.Description: Configure LAPS AD permissions: grants computer objects self-update rights on their LAPS attributes (Set-LapsADComputerSelfPermission), then delegates read and reset access to the specified principals on the target OUs
